title: Randy Lubin & Raph D'Amico - Dungeon Court
speaker: Randy Lubin & Raph D'Amico
description:
This talk is from the 2019 Roguelike Celebration - find out more at https://roguelike.club/event2019.html

Randy and Raph present Dungeon Court, a roguelike-themed improv court simulator. It's an adaptation of Ghost Court by Bully Pulpit Games: https://bullypulpitgames.com/games/ghost-court/
